fact_types.label: Birth
fact_types.definition: A sourced birth date; a birth place uses rico:hasBirthPlace independently, including when no date is known.

fact_types.label: Death
fact_types.definition: A sourced death date; a death place uses rico:hasDeathPlace independently, including when no date is known.

fact_types.label: Residence
fact_types.definition: Residence in a place at a specified time.

fact_types.label: Occupation
fact_types.definition: An occupation, optionally bounded in time.

fact_types.label: Office
fact_types.definition: Holding a Position at a time; person occupiesOrOccupied the position, qualified through PositionHoldingRelation.

fact_types.label: Membership
fact_types.definition: A person isOrWasMemberOf a group, inverse of group hasOrHadMember, qualified through MembershipRelation.

fact_types.label: Education
fact_types.definition: School attendance or education at a specified time.

mapping.reason: TeachingRelation identifies teaching rather than establishing school attendance; retain attendance without asserting a teacher relationship.

fact_types.label: Emigration
fact_types.definition: A dated departure to live elsewhere; establishes neither death nor survival.

mapping.reason: RiC-O MigrationRelation concerns instantiations, not migration of people.

fact_types.label: Survival
fact_types.definition: Evidence that a person was alive at a specified time.

mapping.reason: No dedicated pinned relation expresses evidence of being alive at a time.

fact_types.label: Parenthood
fact_types.definition: Parenthood of an unnamed child without inventing a person node; claims naming a relative use kinship, and links between identified people use relationships. Deprecated in 1.2.0: represent the child as a person and link each parent by parent_of.

mapping.reason: Preserves an unnamed child without inventing a person node for a child relation.

replaced_by.reason: Replace this fact with a parent_of relation from each parent to the child as a person; use a supplied name when the source does not name the child.

fact_types.label: Ghetto role
fact_types.definition: A sourced ghetto activity not expressible as membership or office; use membership or office whenever those fit.

mapping.reason: No precise pinned counterpart for residual ghetto activities beyond membership or office.

fact_types.label: Partisan service
fact_types.definition: A sourced partisan activity beyond membership or office; use membership or office whenever those fit.

mapping.reason: No precise pinned counterpart for residual partisan activities beyond membership or office.

fact_types.label: Deportation
fact_types.definition: A sourced forced removal at a date and place; event participation may link its event.

mapping.reason: No dedicated pinned term captures forced removal of a person.

fact_types.label: Burial
fact_types.definition: A sourced interment, optionally dated and placed; distinct from death.

mapping.reason: No dedicated pinned term captures interment of a person.

fact_types.label: Commemoration
fact_types.definition: A sourced act of remembrance; event participation may link its event.

mapping.reason: No dedicated pinned term captures an act of remembrance of a person.

fact_types.label: Event participation
fact_types.definition: Taking part in an event with an explicit mention role; weddings are events, not marriage facts.

fact_types.label: Other
fact_types.definition: An assertion awaiting an owner-approved type; requires a nonempty proposed_type.

mapping.reason: Retains an assertion pending owner approval of a specific type and mapping.

fact_types.label: Kinship
fact_types.definition: A source's statement that the person is related, in a stated way, to a named person who need not be identified
